basic_details.job_title: Engineering Department UT Chandigarh Executive Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (including short term contract) shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

qualification.details: Officers under the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territory Administrations, Public Sector Undertakings, recognized Universities, recognized Research Institutions, Semi Government, Autonomous Bodies, or Statutory Organizations are eligible: | Holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; OR With five years of service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in posts in Pay Band-3 of Rs. 15,600 - 39,100 with Grade Pay of Rs. 6,600 or equivalent in the parent cadre or department.

selection_process: The selection process involves the assessment of Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee.
how_to_apply: Download the application proforma (Annexure-A) from the official website Chandigarh.gov.in/Public Notice.
Fill in all required details in block letters carefully.
Attach photocopies of ACRs or APARs for the last five years duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary or equivalent.
Attach supporting certificates and documents for essential qualifications and experience claimed.
Get Annexure-II countersigned by the employer or cadre controlling authority with seal, certifying cadre clearance, vigilance clearance, integrity, and absence of penalties.
Forward the complete application through proper channel to the Chief Engineer, Engineering Department, Union Territory, Chandigarh, 1st Floor, Deluxe Building, Sector-9-D, Chandigarh - 160009.
Ensure the application reaches on or before 24 November 2026.
important_instructions: Applications not accompanied by supporting certificates for qualification and experience will not be processed and will be rejected forthwith. Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in direct line of promotion are not eligible for deputation/absorption. Deputationists are not eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. Period of deputation/ISTC shall ordinarily not exceed 4 years. Candidates who apply for the post on deputation basis will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. Incomplete applications forwarded without proper channel or lacking required clearances will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Engineering Department UT Chandigarh Executive Engineer (Electrical) Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: The Engineering Department UT Chandigarh has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the Executive Engineer (Electrical) post on a deputation basis.

content_sections.heading: Engineering Department UT Chandigarh Executive Engineer (Electrical) Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Officers under the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territory Administrations, Public Sector Undertakings, recognized Universities, recognized Research Institutions, Semi Government, Autonomous Bodies, or Statutory Organizations are eligible: Holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; OR With five years of service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in posts in Pay Band-3 of Rs. 15,600 - 39,100 with Grade Pay of Rs. 6,600 or equivalent in the parent cadre or department.

rows.qualification_required: Essential: (i) Bachelor Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute; and (ii) Ten years of experience in Electrical Engineering in the Government Sector. Desirable: Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute. Candidates having a Degree of Associate Member of Engineers in Electrical Engineering (AMIE) from a recognized University/Institute who were enrolled for AMIE up to 31.05.2013 are also eligible for consideration for deputation (ISTC).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Engineering Department UT Chandigarh Executive Engineer (Electrical)
content_sections.text: Download the application proforma (Annexure-A) from the official website Chandigarh.gov.in/Public Notice. Fill in all required details in block letters carefully. Attach photocopies of ACRs or APARs for the last five years duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary or equivalent. Attach supporting certificates and documents for essential qualifications and experience claimed. Get Annexure-II countersigned by the employer or cadre controlling authority with seal, certifying cadre clearance, vigilance clearance, integrity, and absence of penalties. Forward the complete application through proper channel to the Chief Engineer, Engineering Department, Union Territory, Chandigarh, 1st Floor, Deluxe Building, Sector-9-D, Chandigarh - 160009. Ensure the application reaches on or before 24 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Prescribed application format (Annexure-A) Attested photocopies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years Certificates and documents supporting educational qualifications Certificates and documents supporting work experience Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority certification (Annexure-II) including vigilance and integrity clearance

Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in direct line of promotion are not eligible for deputation/absorption. Deputationists are not eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. Period of deputation/ISTC shall ordinarily not exceed 4 years. Candidates who apply for the post on deputation basis will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. Incomplete applications forwarded without proper channel or lacking required clearances will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the Engineering Department UT Chandigarh Executive Engineer (Electrical) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Engineering Department UT Chandigarh to fill 2 vacancies for the post of Executive Engineer (Electrical) on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies (one vacant and one anticipated) are available for the Executive Engineer (Electrical) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving nominations and applications is 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute along with 10 years of experience in Electrical Engineering in the Government Sector.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for Executive Engineer (Electrical)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a pay scale of Level-11 as per CPC, carrying Rs. 67,700 - 2,08,700.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Eligible and willing officers must forward their applications through proper channel in the prescribed format (Annexure-A) along with required documents to the office of the Chief Engineer, UT, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a written examination for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any written examination; selection involves assessment of CV and documents by the Selection Committee.
